faq.refferal2: Will I receive a reward for inviting friends?
faq.refferal_ans2:
Absolutely! We generously reward those who bring new friends to our project

You will receive 10% across three levels (5%-3%-2%) from every purchase your referral makes.
faq.refferal_ans1: Yes, on the page Friends you can invite your friends and view full referral statistics on the same page
faq.balance3: How fast is the balance topped up and withdrawn?
faq.balance_ans3: Deposits and withdrawals in TON are instant and take no more than 30 seconds
faq.balance2: How do I withdraw the balance?
faq.balance_ans2:
На странице Balance there is a form for withdrawing TON. Enter your wallet address and click the MAX button

Minimum withdrawal amount is 0.1 TON
faq.balance1: How to top up the balance?
faq.balance_ans1: Simply go to the page Balance, connect your TON wallet or use a direct transfer via MEMO,
faq.what_civilization_ans3: To start, you need to top up your Balance and buy your first Planet
faq.what_civilization_ans2:
Yes, you actually receive rewards in TON for playing.

However, please note that CivilizationTon is a game where all top-ups are considered voluntary donations.
faq.what_civilization_ans: Civilization is a unique P2E game where you can earn rewards in TON
